title: South Korea to publish draft of comprehensive crypto legal framework this week
reason: A comprehensive regulatory draft including stablecoin issuance rules is a significant adoption and compliance milestone for the crypto sector.

sources.summary: The draft is expected to include a licensing regime for crypto businesses and a bank-centered issuance system for local stablecoins.
